definitions.explanation: Hair worn long, said especially of men, for whom long hair is the marked case. A slightly written word: in conversation people say {髪|かみ}が{長|なが}い or ロン{毛|げ} (casual).

examples.japanese: {長髪|ちょうはつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧。
⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ころ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{長髪|ちょうはつ}だった。
examples.english: I had long hair when I was a student.

examples.japanese: {七十年代|ななじゅうねんだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{長髪|ちょうはつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ジーンズ→ジーンズ：00123_jiinzu⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{格好|かっこう}→格好：01800_kakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In the seventies there were many young people with long hair and jeans.

notes:
USAGE:
The opposite of ⟦{短髪|たんぱつ}→短髪：32996_tanpatsu⟧. Common in descriptions of people (news, profiles): {長髪|ちょうはつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{眼鏡|めがね}をかけた→眼鏡をかける：20967_meganewokakeru⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧ (a long-haired man in glasses). For women's long hair the usual words are ロングヘア or ⟦ロング→ロング：28289_rongu⟧.

WATCH OUT:
The homophone ⟦{挑発|ちょうはつ}→挑発：12827_chouhatsu⟧ means "provocation" (⟦{挑発|ちょうはつ}→挑発：12827_chouhatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧, to rise to the bait).
